title: Timeline cache mixes checkpoint IDs with post IDs
fault_primitive: Detached Redis publisher adds partition checkpoint epochs as post members in existing timeline sorted sets
incident_class: Cancelled timeline migration leaves an unmanaged checkpoint publisher using the live feed key namespace
symptoms: Timeline HTTP requests return 500. Both timeline readers report failures from post-storage-service, which logs Return set incomplete. Pods remain Running and Ready; MongoDB content and deployment configurations remain valid.
